findings.impactStatement: libacl1 remains installed for OS compatibility. Python operations use SQLite backup, byte copy, chown and chmod on fixed private paths; they never call acl_*_file APIs or launch ACL-preserving utilities. Node serves as UID1000 with zero capabilities. Root init-volumes performs only fixed-path chown/chmod/makedirs, without ACL calls or untrusted requests.
findings.vendorRemedy: acl 2.4.0 adds new *_at ABI; Debian schedules a point-release fix and warns individual backports/ABI conflicts. Prefer the Debian package over replacing libacl ad hoc.
